title: What It Actually Looks Like to Love Your Hometown and Still Leave It
caption:
Thanksgiving weekend back home hits different once you've moved away. Same streets, same church, same bedroom. And tomorrow you drive back.

You can love where you're from and still go where God sends you. Those aren't opposites.

Thank God for the people who built you. Leave because you're sent, not because you're running. Plant yourself where you land, church in the first month. And keep calling the ones who stayed.

"Go from your country and your kindred and your father's house to the land that I will show you." Genesis 12:1

Save this for the drive back. Send it to the guy who moved away with you.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #calling #home
